steps: Build the draw for an eight-team division; try to draw the second half of the season
expected: Rounds 1–14 from one draw, home and away reversed in the second leg
actual: One run makes seven rounds; a second run is allowed and labels its games Round 1–7 again, with nobody's home game reversed

steps: Draw a season across the NSW autumn school holidays
expected: A week the league leaves out (17 April) has no games; later rounds move on a week
actual: The generator spaces rounds evenly and cannot leave a week out; the league would move every game of the round by hand

steps: Draw a season whose rounds cross 4 April 2027 (daylight saving ends); compare a division's first kick-off on 27 March and 10 April
expected: The same clock time (9 am stays 9 am)
actual: Round dates were p_start_at + n days on a timestamptz; in a UTC session (PostgREST) that is n × 24 hours, so every kick-off after the change was an hour earlier and the pitch fit then pushed it to the next free slot. Found by inspection while fixing the draw; the check that would have caught it is OFF7a
fixed: 0276: round dates worked out in the competition's zone

steps: Move a game onto another field (or ground) by name with reschedule_fixture
expected: The game is on that pitch; the run sheet, the fixture and every family's game page say the new field
actual: The labels were written and pitch_id stayed on the old pitch, so the booking guard put the old field's name straight back; a move to another ground left venue_id on the old ground while the label said the new one
fixed: 0276: apply_reschedule resolves the ground and field to the pitch

steps: Open the game page as a family after the league moved the game to Field 3
expected: "Harbour Park · Field 3" on the game page, and a push that the field changed
actual: The mirrored event carried only the ground, so no family could see which field, and a field change sent nothing
fixed: 0276: the field in the mirrored event's venue; a field change is a change families hear

steps: Call off a ground, a pitch or a round with referees appointed; move a game
expected: Every appointed referee is told their game is off or moved, a text inside 24 hours
actual: Every family and coach was told; no referee was

steps: A referee files a report with abuse in it
expected: The coordinator and the discipline officer are told at once
actual: The report sat on the appointments screen until someone looked
fixed: 0276: a report of abuse, an injury or an incident is pushed

steps: Allocate a Saturday with under-18 referees in the pool
expected: An under-18 referee is never put on an U15 or older game
actual: The allocator did not consider a referee's age

steps: A coach files an injury from the ground
expected: The Welfare officer and the President are told at once
actual: The report reached nobody until someone opened the register

steps: Submit a sheet of six for a nine-a-side division
actual: Accepted with six players, nothing said

expected: Remaining games become byes, played games stand, opponents' families see the game is off, the entry is marked withdrawn
actual: No withdraw action: the league would give each game a bye by hand (set_bye), whose mirror left the opponents' game live, or delete the entry and every played game with it
fixed: 0276: withdraw_entry; a bye is mirrored as a called-off game

steps: Set up finals for a one-table division; a semi-final is drawn after extra time
expected: Semi-finals for the top four and a grand final; the shootout winner goes through
actual: A one-table division got a final only; a drawn knockout promoted nobody

steps: Fifty clubs' entry fees still owed in April
